title: Signature 34 · Heavy Muscle · Palekh · Snowy Birch
prompt:
Subject: ONE Black woman in her late 30s, long voluminous curls with a delicate gold tiara.

Physique: THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH, blue-black void complexion darker than night sky, not brown, her face the same deep tone with natural highlights and clearly defined features, not flat. Heavy muscular physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits, around 500 pounds — enormously broad muscular shoulders as wide as her hips, massive arms with big defined biceps, colossal thighs with powerful defined quads, a gigantic bust, no waist at all, the torso a thick straight column, and only the belly soft and round, projecting forward past the chest line, no visible abs, dominating the frame. Feminine face, warm expression, not masculine, no bodybuilder look.

Body Art: Full body Russian Palekh lacquer painting painted directly on bare skin, covering every inch from neck to ankle without exception. Deep glossy black lacquer densely covered with fine gold-leaf vine scrolls, firebird feather ornaments, and jewel-tone red, blue, and green flowers. The gold scrolls wrap the swell of the shoulders and biceps, curve around the round belly, and sweep along the quads. No borders, no bands, not a corset. Densely filled with no plain skin, covering the shoulders and arms completely down to the wrists and the legs down to the ankles.

Pose: Standing full frontal in a wide stance with shoulders squared, arms hanging relaxed slightly away from the body.

Footwear: Extremely high red lacquer platform stiletto mules with gold straps. Nails: extra long almond, red with gold tips.

Background & Lighting: A snowy birch forest on a bright winter morning, white snow and pale trunks, the background much lighter than her body, soft low sunlight carving the round forward curve of the soft belly and the swell of the shoulders, biceps, and quads, making the gold leaf glow, bright highlights on every glossy curve. Extreme high-gloss lacquer finish. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
